_comment: Source-of-truth freshness manifest for the OpenELIS Playwright suite. `status` per spec is auto-refreshed from a Playwright JSON run by scripts/refresh-freshness.mjs; `drift`/`notes` are curated by hand. status: fresh (green, verified passing on lastBuild) | partial (green core, a known non-blocking drift/flake) | drift (fails on real UI/route drift — needs a spec update) | unknown (not run against lastBuild yet).

driftCauses.OGC-1132: Unified /order/enter drops the sample's tests (Hibernate type-mismatch) — order via legacy /SamplePatientEntry (placeLegacySerumOrder).
driftCauses.OGC-1142-editor: Test Catalog editor rework changed the UI new-test create form + add-component + ranges dialog — configure via REST (createTestViaRest / setComponentViaRest / setNormalCriticalRangeViaRest).
driftCauses.login-attrs: Reworked login lost input name/id — use placeholder*="ser" + defensive early-return under storageState.
driftCauses.unified-results: OGC-1020 R1 unified /Results worklist is flag-gated (RESULTS_ENTRY_UNIFIED_ROUTE).
driftCauses.load-flake: Order→result E2E specs fail DETERMINISTICALLY under full-suite load (net::ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES / browser crashes / 500s persist across retries) but PASS in isolation. Not spec drift and not fixed by retries — run them alone via e2e.config.ts (isolated tier). all-tc.config now excludes them.
driftCauses.env-vector-target-gap: The Environmental/Vector domain order UI is NOT deployed on testing.openelis-global.org (v3.2.1.11): /order/environmental/enter and /order/vector/enter render only the nav shell (no wizard, no step chrome), and the legacy /SamplePatientEntry sample-type list carries only clinical/pathology types (Serum, Whole Blood, Sputum, Histopathology, …) — NO Water or vector types. So an env/vector order cannot be placed on testing by any path. These specs are correct and green on indonesiademo (which has the domain). Run env/vector specs against BASE=https://indonesiademo.openelis-global.org, not testing. Directly probed env 2026-07-27; vector shares the identical domain-deployment gap.
driftCauses.seeder-indonesiademo: Demo-data seeder spec (self-grounding, idempotent) intended to run one-at-a-time against indonesiademo to populate demo data; it is not a regression test for testing and is expected to no-op/fail there. Excluded from testing pass-rate.
